rv.q: Towne is delightfully manipulative as Hesione, and Lubatti is superb as the silkily seductive Hector. Addison manages to reveal the vulnerability underlying Mangan’s rough reputation, and Barlas is very funny as the easily subdued Randall.
This is a richly entertaining production, honoring both Shaw's wit and his dismay at the superficiality of society.

cn.t: Antaeus Theatre Company's production of Shaw's dark comedy delivers comedic highs and rhetorical sharpness, though it may lack some of the play's inherent magic—still, there's ample charm to be found.
